account.confirmedBody: Open Coach Poulpy on the phone you signed up with: it signs you in and sends your training.
account.confirmedPoulpy: Lifting your training into the cloud. Eight tentacles, no waiting.
account.confirmExpiredBody: It may have been used already, or it expired after 24 hours. Sign up again in the app with the same address and we’ll send a new one.
account.resetExpiredBody: It may have been used already, or it expired after an hour. In the app, tap “Forgot your password?” to get a new one.
account.resetIntro: Every phone signed in to this account will be signed out.
account.savedBody: Every phone was signed out. Open Coach Poulpy and sign in with your new password.
account.errorOffline: Coach Poulpy can’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.

admin.signInIntro: The admin is for the people who look after Coach Poulpy.
admin.errorSignIn: Wrong email or password, or this account isn’t an admin’s.
admin.errorTooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
admin.errorOffline: Coach Poulpy can’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
admin.auditIntro: Everything an admin changed, newest first. Only admins see this.
admin.auditEmpty: Nothing yet. Admin changes show up here.
admin.auditError: The audit log can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.accountsIntro: Every account, with its state and never its workouts or health data. Open one to disable or delete it.
admin.accountsNoneHint: Change or clear the filters to see more accounts.
admin.accountsError: The account can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.disableHint: Disabling signs this account out everywhere and blocks sign-in until you enable it again. Nothing is deleted.
admin.ownAccount: This is your own account. You can’t disable or delete it here.
admin.deleteBody: This removes {email} and everything saved for it, for good. It is the same deletion the user can ask for in the app. It cannot be undone.
admin.settingsIntro: Changes take effect on the next email. Every change is written to the audit log.
admin.settingsError: The settings can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.mailFromHint: The address emails come from, such as Coach Poulpy <hello@example.com>.
admin.mailFromInvalid: This is not an email address. Use the form name@example.com.
admin.mailFromSaved: Saved. The next email comes from this address.
admin.saveError: The address can’t be saved. Try again.
admin.testEmailHint: Sends a message to {email} with the saved settings.
admin.testEmailFailed: The test email was not sent. The mail server said: {error}
admin.mailServerNote: The mail server (host, port, user and password) is set on the server and is not editable here.

app.passwordBody: We email you a link to choose a new password. Every device you are signed in on is signed out when you use it.
app.resetLinkSent: If the address belongs to an account, a link is on its way.
app.dataBody: Your workouts, sessions and body log live on your phone and follow your account. To change them, open the app.
